I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

It follows `DESIGN.md` for the page layout, button, list and card rules.
- **Layout:** The page sits on white. The content column is 1120px wide with 48px above it. The "Notifications" heading is on the left, and the "Mark All as Read" button is on the right.
- **List:** The six notifications are in one bordered card, in 52px rows with dividers. The first three are unread. They have a blue dot and bold ink text, and the read ones are muted. Timestamps are right-aligned.
- **Tokens:** I copied only the tokens the page uses from `tokens.css` into an inline `<style>` block, so the file is self-contained.

- **Fonts:** There are no font files in the folder. Unbounded and Archivo will fall back to the system sans-serif unless they're installed locally. Because of that, the heading won't look like the real Unbounded Light capitals.
- **Unread state:** The unread state isn't colour-only. The first three rows also carry a hidden "Unread:" label for screen readers.
